note.en: The sign issue in the template numerator (T25) and the reference value (T24) are pending.

definition.zh-TW: 營業活動的現金扣掉股利後，有多少比例重新投入公司的資產（毛額固定資產、長期投資、其他資產與營運資金）。數值越高表示公司把賺到的現金留下來擴充。
definition.en: The share of operating cash, after dividends, that is reinvested in the company's assets (gross fixed assets, long-term investments, other assets and working capital). Higher means more of the cash earned is kept to grow the business.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
